title: Lockheed's quantum magnetometer modelled on the robin's cry4 protein

tellings.quote: lockheed observed these birds right or like the physics and and they decided can we replicate this with existing sensors can we create a quantum sensor that does the same thing that these birds are doing to detect the earth's magnetic fields and they succeeded as of six years ago they created what's called the dark ice magnetometer

plain: Around 2016, the American aerospace company Lockheed is said to have studied how birds such as robins sense the earth's magnetic field, through a protein called cry4, and to have copied that physics in a quantum sensor it calls the dark ice magnetometer. A researcher named Deep Prasad tells this without naming a source, as an example of engineers learning from nature at the quantum level.
